4use crate::third_party::vello_common::encode::{FocalData, RadialKind};
5use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::{Simd, SimdBase, SimdFloat, f32x8};
6use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::common::gradient::SimdGradientKind;
7
8pub(crate) enum SimdRadialKindInner<S: Simd> {
9    Radial { bias: f32x8<S>, scale: f32x8<S> },
10    Strip { scaled_r0_squared: f32x8<S> },
11    Focal { focal_data: FocalData, fp0: f32x8<S>, fp1: f32x8<S> },
12}
13
14pub(crate) struct SimdRadialKind<S: Simd> {
15    inner: SimdRadialKindInner<S>,
16}
17
18impl<S: Simd> SimdRadialKind<S> {
19    pub(crate) fn new(simd: S, kind: &RadialKind) -> Self {
20        let inner = match kind {
21            RadialKind::Radial { bias, scale } => SimdRadialKindInner::Radial { bias: f32x8::splat(simd, *bias), scale: f32x8::splat(simd, *scale) },
22            RadialKind::Strip { scaled_r0_squared } => SimdRadialKindInner::Strip { scaled_r0_squared: f32x8::splat(simd, *scaled_r0_squared) },
23            RadialKind::Focal { focal_data, fp0, fp1 } => {
24                SimdRadialKindInner::Focal { fp0: f32x8::splat(simd, *fp0), fp1: f32x8::splat(simd, *fp1), focal_data: *focal_data }
25            }
26        };
27
28        Self { inner }
29    }
30}
31
32impl<S: Simd> SimdGradientKind<S> for SimdRadialKind<S> {
33    #[inline(always)]
34    fn cur_pos(&self, x_pos: f32x8<S>, y_pos: f32x8<S>) -> f32x8<S> {
35        let simd = x_pos.simd;
36
37        match &self.inner {
38            SimdRadialKindInner::Radial { bias, scale } => {
39                let radius = (x_pos * x_pos + y_pos * y_pos).sqrt();
40
41                *bias + radius * *scale
42            }
43            SimdRadialKindInner::Strip { scaled_r0_squared } => {
44                let p1 = *scaled_r0_squared - y_pos * y_pos;
45
46                let mask = simd.simd_lt_f32x8(p1, f32x8::splat(simd, 0.0));
47                simd.select_f32x8(mask, f32x8::splat(simd, f32::NAN), x_pos + p1.sqrt())
48            }
49            SimdRadialKindInner::Focal { focal_data, fp0, fp1 } => {
50                let mut t = if focal_data.is_focal_on_circle() {
51                    x_pos + y_pos * y_pos / x_pos
52                } else if focal_data.is_well_behaved() {
53                    (x_pos * x_pos + y_pos * y_pos).sqrt() - x_pos * *fp0
54                } else if focal_data.is_swapped() || (1.0 - focal_data.f_focal_x < 0.0) {
55                    f32x8::splat(simd, -1.0) * (x_pos * x_pos - y_pos * y_pos).sqrt() - x_pos * *fp0
56                } else {
57                    (x_pos * x_pos - y_pos * y_pos).sqrt() - x_pos * *fp0
58                };
59
60                if !focal_data.is_well_behaved() {
61                    // Radii < 0 should be masked out, too.
62                    let is_degenerate = simd.simd_le_f32x8(t, f32x8::splat(simd, 0.0));
63
64                    t = simd.select_f32x8(is_degenerate, f32x8::splat(simd, f32::NAN), t);
65                }
66
67                if 1.0 - focal_data.f_focal_x < 0.0 {
68                    t = f32x8::splat(simd, -1.0) * t;
69                }
70
71                if !focal_data.is_natively_focal() {
72                    t += *fp1;
73                }
74
75                if focal_data.is_swapped() {
76                    t = f32x8::splat(simd, 1.0) - t;
77                }
78
79                t
80            }
81        }
82    }
83}
